summary.intent: Fix a review finding on PR #482 (group release notes dropping bump groups) and then start the next round of improvements to the callisto release tooling.
summary.outcome: The finding was fixed in commit 2bc1767 with a regression test, verified locally, and resolved on the trail. The 'Also bumped' line change was investigated and abandoned, so no new PR was started. The remaining roadmap options (A-D) await a user decision.

repo: Fixed-group release notes: when the release owner has only the 'Released together with' line, its section has no headings, so group_release_notes took the flat path and dropped members' Major/Minor/Patch groups.
The bug did not show on #468 because the owner (callisto-cli) has its own changes there, so a group-only owner case was untested.
The original test covered only the renderer, not the notes merger that consumes its output, so the gap went unnoticed.

The 'Also bumped' line in the release PR body is generated in crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/pr_body.rs and explains why packages appear with no changes of their own; the summary table only says 'Fixed group'.
Pre-push checks include lint, doc-check, test and two workflow contract scripts.
Commits are signed and verified via GitHub's commit verification reason (expects 'valid').

code.finding: Contains the 'Also bumped' line logic; judged useful for explaining unchanged packages, so left unchanged.

workflow: Use git worktrees branched from origin/main for independent PRs, and remove the worktree and branch if the work is abandoned with nothing committed.
Avoid stacking new PRs on one still pending review; the user asked for this.
Verify a regression test by disabling the fix and confirming it fails.
Resolve trail findings with `entire trail finding resolve <id> --branch <branch> -m <message>` after pushing the fix.
Confirm a fix commit's signature shows 'valid' on GitHub and that the PR head matches it before resolving.

friction: The user asked to 'start the next improvements', but the only small remaining candidate (the 'Also bumped' line) was cosmetic and not worth changing, so the worktree was created and then discarded.
PR #482 still has no review, which blocks sequencing of further work.
CI had not yet run on the fix commit when the summary was written.
open_items: Review #482 and merge or hold #468 (needs the user).
After #482 merges, check that the next release PR's member changelogs have no Minor heading.
Choose among: A) link each change to its PR and author (recommended), B) require CI on main (needs confirmed check names), C) custom renderers/templates, D) large-repo rollups.
Option B is a repo setting; a wrong check name would block all merges.
